name: velocut
description: Edit video and direct 3D scenes in Velocut. Starts a prebuilt local Studio automatically.

interface.shortDescription: Model and direct scenes in your live editor.
interface.longDescription: Use Codex to edit timelines, configure media models, create 3D scenes and inspect rendered results. The matching prebuilt Studio starts on first use. Requires Node.js 22.6+ and npm; no source checkout or separate reasoning-model API key.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my local Velocut editor.
Build a cafe scene with tables and warm lighting.
Inspect my scene and improve its camera composition.
